name: Frigate NVR

secret.help: Long random string, the same as proxy.auth_secret in the Frigate config.

setup:
Home Assistant admins become Frigate admins, everyone else viewer. Add to the Frigate config:

```yaml
auth:
  proxy:
    auth_secret: <same secret>
    header_map:
      user: remote-user
      role: remote-groups
    default_role: viewer
```
